title: `FeeLib` calculations can revert
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `FeeLib` library is based on the [Uniswap's V3 `PositionValue` library](https://github.com/Uniswap/v3-periphery/blob/main/contracts/libraries/PositionValue.sol). However, it is not taken into account that the fee calculations [expect overflows and underflows](https://github.com/Uniswap/v3-periphery/issues/198). This is not an issue in the original library, as it uses a solc version lower than 0.8.0, which does not revert to overflow/underflow.
